transcript.content: Hello. What brings you into the clinic today?
My eating’s gotten really off. Some days before a shift, I can barely manage coffee and a granola bar, and my scrubs have been hanging loose. I’m not trying to lose weight.
What makes it difficult for you to eat before your shifts?

I just don’t seem to have much appetite before work. I’ll try, but a lot of mornings all I can manage is coffee and maybe a granola bar. Then I notice my scrubs are getting loose, which worries me because I’m not trying to lose weight.
Do you feel anxious or nervous before heading into work?
I’m not really sure. I haven’t noticed feeling especially nervous before work—I just don’t have much appetite.
Aside from the changes in your appetite, how has your mood been lately?
Most mornings I wake up feeling heavy and hollow, like the day’s already ruined before I even put on my badge.
How long have you been feeling this heavy and hollow feeling?
I’d say it settled in later, and it’s been pretty steady for about a year and four months now.
Before this past year and four months, had you been dealing with a low or depressed mood as well?
Yeah, I had been feeling low before that too. Most mornings I’d wake up feeling heavy and hollow, like the day was already ruined before I even got my badge on.
In total, counting that earlier period as well, how long have you been dealing with this low mood?
Including before that, it’s been going on for about a year and four months, pretty steadily.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in activities you normally enjoy?

Yeah. I used to run in Van Cortlandt Park, take photos, play chess with friends. Now I mostly just think, what’s the point? I end up staying home, scrolling on my phone or checking my budget spreadsheet instead.
How has your sleep been during this time?

My sleep’s pretty broken up. I lie there replaying work stuff and listening for noises, and then I wake up around three or four in the morning. After that I usually can’t really settle back down before the alarm.
How have your energy levels been throughout the day?
Even if I’ve been in bed all night, I wake up feeling like I’ve worked a double shift. By lunchtime I’m really struggling to keep my thoughts together.
During this low period, have you had any thoughts that life isn't worth living, or thoughts of hurting yourself?
I haven’t made any plan to hurt myself. But… I do catch myself wishing I just wouldn’t wake up, or thinking it might be easier if I just disappeared.
